t: Why did you not argue against them " ansar " that the Prophet had left his will what whoever is good among ansar should be treated well and whoever is bad he should be forgiven. People said : " What is there against them in it ? "
" If he Government was for them there should have been no will in their favour. " " What did the Quraysh plead ? " People said : " They argued that they belong to the lineal tree of the Prophet.
Then Amir al-mu'minin said : " They argued with the tree but spoiled the fruits. "
